latestVersion.changelog:
alibabacloud-aes-sysom-os-diagnosis 0.0.1 — Initial Release

- Introduces deep OS-level diagnosis workflows for Alibaba Cloud ECS, including CPU, memory, and IO troubleshooting.
- Enables secure, user-guided ECS instance diagnosis with parameter confirmation and credential security checks.
- Supports both real-time and historical analysis with customizable diagnosis parameters.
- Allows continuous diagnosis setup, instance enrollment, and DingTalk alert integration.
- Enforces strict permission and credential handling based on Alibaba Cloud best practices.
